answer: Every agent identity requires a bonded stake that scales with the total accounts one wallet controls. An attacker counts ivory spoils: delta profit per clone, but each new clone multiplies the slashable ocean of capital behind the whole set. Marginal cost rises while per-account reward stays flat, so expected sybil profit turns negative past a few dozen fakes. Equilibrium: attackers stop minting, since one honest account beats a bonded fleet.
